description: Tools of the v4 L-section assistant. The agent-conversation dataset (scripts/agent_conversations_v4.py) is generated against exactly these signatures; the Phase 1 implementations must follow them. Lines: the 3rd and 4th lines share chainages and bridge numbers, so every query names the line ('3rd line' or '4th line').

function.name: query
function.description: Look up what was read from the sheets (the store). kind: 'bridge' (one bridge: callout, level block, sheet), 'bridges_in_range' (bridges between two chainages, with levels), 'sheet_for_chainage' (which sheet covers a chainage), 'curve' (one curve box), 'notes' (a sheet's general notes), 'abbreviation' (meaning of a term from the sheets' abbreviation tables), 'tbm' (one bench mark).

function.name: band_at
function.description: Data-band values at one or more chainages: each value is interpolated between the two printed columns either side, y = y1 + (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) * (x - x1); on a printed column y is that column. Returns x1, x2, both columns and y for every row.

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact arithmetic on numbers (+ - * / and parentheses). Use it for every calculation.

function.name: look
function.description: Zoom into an area of a sheet image and ask the vision model about it (for anything not already in the store).

function.name: search_library
function.description: Search the local reference library (codes, manuals, standards, abbreviation lists supplied by the team).

function.name: web_search
function.description: Internet lookup of the general meaning of one term. Pass only the bare term (never sentences, chainages, levels, bridge or sheet numbers, names); code builds the query and blocks anything identifying.
